summary: Season 9 'The Undertow Approaches' launches on October 23, introducing the underground region Duskport along with 9 new heroes. The update features 4 exclusive Mythic Artifacts tailored to specific heroes and 7 new gear sets (3 Legendary and 4 Mythic). Additionally, mid-season content introduces the Glory Colosseum multi-team PvP mode, the Ancient Rune Oath event, Magichess Season 4 (Realm of Strife), and a new skin for Saverio.

heroes.name: Sia
heroes.verdict: Necrosis support converting damage to shields and heals
heroes.note: Converts reduced damage into Mercy to apply shields, heals, and cleanses while inflicting Attack and Recharging Speed penalties on enemies.

heroes.name: Celestine
heroes.verdict: Ice support granting permanent team buffs on debuff resist
heroes.note: Grants random permanent buffs to allies upon resisting debuffs, alongside heals, shields, max HP boosts, and enemy damage output reductions.

heroes.name: Syonis
heroes.verdict: Necrosis Shadow hero with a 1v1 Energy Drain Zone
heroes.note: Reduces enemy Defense, boosts Shadow allies' Attack, and pulls himself and the highest-Attack enemy into an isolated 1v1 duel zone.

heroes.name: Rhyviel
heroes.verdict: Poison Corrosion hero that scales Corrosion stacks
heroes.note: Reduces enemy Defense with Rending Bite, applies Corrosion directly once maxed, and takes reduced damage from affected targets.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.verdict: Radiance Aura engine and damage buffer
heroes.note: Channels Aura energy and damage buffs to same-school allies and triggers extra attacks for Aura heroes following his ultimate.

heroes.name: Fyrenzur
heroes.verdict: Fire support centered around Dodge synergy
heroes.note: Grants Dodge Up to allies, heals them when dodging, cleanses debuffs, and inflicts Attack and Recharging Speed penalties.

heroes.name: Amalfriede
heroes.verdict: Werewolf Rune Mage with random debuffs and AoE Silence
heroes.note: Applies random debuffs on hit, scales her ultimate damage based on debuffs inflicted, grants self Accuracy and Shield, and silences AoE targets.

heroes.name: Longbeau
heroes.verdict: Ice support utilizing White and Black rat effects
heroes.note: Uses White Rat to mitigate damage and heal allies, and Black Rat to reflect debuffs or control effects back onto enemy attackers.

heroes.name: Tallyn
heroes.verdict: Lightning support with stuns, shields, and Gatekeeper effect
heroes.note: Accumulates Static stacks to stun enemies and shield allies, while his ultimate grants team shields and the Gatekeeper damage/stun effect.

meta_changes: Season 9 launches October 23 introducing Duskport, 9 new heroes, 4 exclusive Mythic Artifacts, and 7 new gear sets.
Glory Colosseum introduces a multi-team PvP format mid-season with Support Legacy Mark bonuses.
Magichess Season 4 (Realm of Strife) adds new heroes, the Conqueror bond, Reversal talent branch, and 20 tactical adventure stages.
tips: Look out for hero-exclusive Mythic Artifacts: Wings of Resentment (Szecedith), Duskmire Crystalwing (Larclys), Moonlit Gemstone Necklace (Monelisse), and Death-Knell Horn (Blah Blah).
Explore new Mythic gear sets like Azure Prophecy to convert non-damaging debuffs into increased damage taken by target enemies.
Prepare multi-team compositions for the mid-season Glory Colosseum PvP mode to capitalize on school-specific Support Legacy Marks.
title: Dragonheir Season 9: The Undertow Approaches | 9 New Heroes, Mythic Sets & Glory Colosseum
